```ad-check
title: ### Stat Beschreibung:
Typ: Spell
Element: Deathfire
Icon: icons/magic/death/hand-undead-skeleton-fire-pink.webp
Category: Summoning
Cost: 2 Actions, 20 IP
Range: 12m
Target: Single Corpse
Check: No Check
Duration: 10 turns
Effect: On cast:
Spawn a deathfire elemental at target corpse location. 

The elemental:
- Cannot hold, carry items or speak.
- Attacks deal 1d8 fire damage.
- Has 10 stats across the board.

Empower: You may spend additional IP when summoning it to make it stronger:
- +20 IP: +1 size, +5 to all stats, +1d8 fire damage
- +40 IP: +2 sizes, +10 to all stats, +2d8 fire damage
- +60 IP: +3 sizes, +15 to all stats, +3d8 fire damage
```
